slides.headline: Gates: no safeguards is irresponsible
slides.body: Bill Gates said skipping AI safety guards is completely irresponsible this week.

slides.headline: Safeguards mean AI won't harm you
slides.body: Safeguards are rules that stop AI from lying, leaking data, or acting dangerously.

slides.headline: No global rules exist yet
slides.body: Companies set their own standards. Nothing forces them to protect users first.

slides.headline: Your phone apps may skip them
slides.body: Free AI tools you use daily often have weaker guards than enterprise versions.

slides.headline: Follow for AI safety updates
slides.body: We explain what AI rules mean for your privacy and money.
